gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-tamil-s: Geometric and clean, Conthrax draws a wide-mouthed a and capitals that barely rise above the lowercase. Noto Sans Tamil Supplement handles the quieter work, with round forms like open parentheses and a stocky, solid line.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-tangsa: Sharp, wide, a little futuristic. Conthrax runs its letters without any swell or hairline, and Noto Sans Tangsa follows with round, inviting shapes and short stems that keep a paragraph moving smoothly.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-tc: Noto Sans TC brings large open counters and curves that flare outward instead of curling in. Noto Sans TC over a full page feels easygoing, while Conthrax above it stays a plain, unshaded line that never swells.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-thai-lo: Conthrax has zero stroke modulation, every line drawn as if by one unvarying tool, with a wide-mouthed a for flavor. And Noto Sans Thai Looped is the sturdier partner, its deep bodies looking bold with spacious gaps at the curve ends.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-vai:
Conthrax draws every stroke with zero modulation, like wire.

Noto Sans Vai then carries a longer read gently, its words forming solid blocks and its curves leaving generous space before each stem.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-vithkuq: Conthrax has a drafting-pen outline quality, one constant nib width throughout, with a wide-mouthed a. Noto Sans Vithkuqi keeps open throats on a, c, e and s, and body text can stay comfortably modest beside the heading.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-warang-: Stems and arcs in lockstep, geometric and crisp. Yet Noto Sans Warang Citi goes the other way, its words reading as solid blocks with wide channels leading into every counter.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-yi:
Conthrax glides under the eye like wire.

Noto Sans Yi gives it a deep-bodied lowercase partner, rounds left unsealed like an unlatched hook, so the display voice and the text sit side by side with clear roles.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-zanabaz: Neon-tube lines, wide and glowing. Conthrax is best at showing off that uniform stroke, while Noto Sans Zanabazar Square is best at keeping tiny sizes crisp, thanks to its wide gaps and soaring x-height.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-traditional-: Conthrax has no hairlines and no swells anywhere, just geometric strokes with a wide-mouthed a. Noto Traditional Nushu follows with a broad-nibbed pen stroke that never curls shut, its bowls filling the line comfortably.
